plugins.name: disciplined-thinking
plugins.description: Core mental models, decision chains, and task routing for structured executive analysis.

plugins.name: delivery-and-flow
plugins.description: Diagnose and improve delivery flow: value streams, WIP, metrics, org design, and portfolio prioritization.

plugins.name: consulting-craft
plugins.description: Executive problem structuring, communication, and consulting engagement discipline.

chainDescriptionOverrides.pricing-decision: Runs an eight-step pricing decision chain from first principles through experiments and margin of safety. Use when setting or changing prices, packaging, or monetization.
chainDescriptionOverrides.market-entry: Structured market entry analysis: opportunity, defensibility, assumptions, and entry mode. Use when entering a new market, segment, or geography.
chainDescriptionOverrides.hiring-decision: Hiring decision chain: role outcomes, failure modes, evidence, and culture fit. Use for significant hires or role design.
chainDescriptionOverrides.product-launch: Product or feature launch chain: assumptions, readiness, metrics, and failure modes. Use before launches or major releases.
chainDescriptionOverrides.investment-decision: Capital allocation chain: thesis, downside, alternatives, and monitoring. Use for investments of money or strategic capacity.
chainDescriptionOverrides.should-i-quit: Quit-or-stay decision chain separating signal from noise. Use when considering leaving a role, company, or project.
chainDescriptionOverrides.life-decision: Major life decision chain with reversibility and probabilistic scenarios. Use for long-horizon personal or career choices.
chainDescriptionOverrides.capacity-planning: Eight-step capacity planning chain before committing resources. Use when planning team or portfolio capacity.
chainDescriptionOverrides.transformation: Organizational transformation readiness and sequencing chain. Use for large change programs.
chainDescriptionOverrides.improve-delivery-flow: Eight-step flow improvement chain: VSM, bottlenecks, WIP, forecasting, metrics, PDCA. Use for slow delivery, missed dates, or flow reviews.
chainDescriptionOverrides.org-design-for-flow: Org design diagnostic chain: value stream, team topologies, Conway, dependencies. Use when structure blocks flow.
chainDescriptionOverrides.work-to-be-done: Ten-step chain from outcome through theory of change, MECE work tree, prioritization, and capacity check. Use when scoping what must be built or delivered before execution.

toolkits.description: Maps value stream, finds bottlenecks and queue delay, estimates cycle time from WIP and throughput. Use for slow delivery, missed dates, everyone busy, or executive lead-time questions.
deliverableSections: Current-state flow map (steps, wait times, handoffs)
Little's Law check (WIP, throughput, predicted cycle time)

toolkits.description: Designs WIP limits, pull policies, and flow-based commitments. Use when starting kanban, breaking WIP limits, or defining lead-time promises.
deliverableSections: Proposed WIP limits per stage (with rationale)
Lead time vs cycle time definitions for stakeholders

toolkits.description: Defines delivery and flow metrics, variability, and probabilistic forecasts. Use for dashboards, predictability, SLA design, or executive reporting.
deliverableSections: Baseline and target percentiles (not averages only)
Goodhart risks (how metrics could be gamed)

toolkits.description: Aligns teams and dependencies to value streams using team topologies and Conway. Use for reorgs, platform teams, or cross-team blocking work.
deliverableSections: Inverse Conway moves (team changes to get desired flow)

toolkits.description: Prioritizes work under scarce capacity using cost of delay, WSJF, and kill criteria. Use for portfolio debates, roadmaps, or what to stop.
deliverableSections: Scarcity constraint (what is the real bottleneck)
What to stop or defer (kill criteria applied)
Governance check (funding, WIP at portfolio level)

toolkits.description: Structures ambiguous problems with MECE issue trees and hypothesis-driven consulting. Use for steering committees, problem statements, or issue trees.
deliverableSections: What would falsify the leading hypothesis

toolkits.description: Produces answer-first executive communication using the pyramid principle. Use for board decks, exec memos, or steering updates.
Frames consulting engagements: lifecycle, scope, and contracting. Use when scoping work, SOWs, or diagnose-design-deliver-detach.
Applies core mental models (first principles, inversion, incentives, bottlenecks, bias checks) to the user's situation. Use for ambiguous decisions, strategy, or when no specialized chain fits.
deliverableSections: Primary model lens used and why

routers.description: Classifies the user's task and routes to the best chain or toolkit skill. Use at the start of ambiguous consulting, delivery, or executive requests.
